title: Design In-Memory File System
goal: Maintain directories and file contents while answering sorted listings and reads.
strategy: A directory trie resolves each path component. Directory creation fills missing ancestors; appends modify one file; listing a directory sorts its immediate names, while listing a file returns only its own name.

edgeCases: An empty root can be listed repeatedly
Repeated mkdir preserves files and append preserves earlier content
Listing sorts immediate names without descending into folders
